ats.title: Job-board platforms
ats.description: Only jobs from these applicant tracking systems. Empty = all eight.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: 2-letter ISO country codes (e.g. "US", "DE", "GB"). A job matches when any of its country_codes is listed; jobs whose location names no country (e.g. just "Remote") are excluded when this is set. Empty = worldwide.

remote.title: Remote
remote.description: remote_only: remote jobs only. onsite_only: excludes jobs marked remote (on-site, hybrid and unspecified remain).

seniority.title: Seniority
seniority.description: Only jobs at these levels, read from the job title by fixed rules (no AI): intern, entry, mid, senior, lead, manager (people managers; not Product/Project/Account Manager), director (Director, Head of, VP), executive (C-level, SVP, founder). Jobs whose title has no level marker are excluded when this is set. Empty = all.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within (days)
postedWithinDays.description: Only jobs first published in the last N days. Empty = any age (the whole index).

sinceLastRun.title: Only jobs not delivered before
sinceLastRun.description: Remembers every job this Actor delivered for the same filters (in a named key-value store in your Apify account) and skips it on later runs, so a daily schedule gets each job once and is never charged twice. A run that stops at maxResults continues where it stopped next time.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of jobs to deliver (and charge for) in this run. Newest jobs come first.

fields.title: Output fields
fields.description: Keep only these fields in each row (smaller datasets and faster exports). Empty = all fields (the same schema as Jobs Feed API).
